title: “Radical Futures” Discussion Guide
summary: A discussion guide on the present and future of creative coding. Based on “Radical Futures: Creative Code, Agency, and Humanity,” Processing’s 25th anniversary exhibition at Ars Electronica 2026.
zine_format: 8-page (2-sheet) booklet. Available on both US Letter and A4. For folding instructions, visit https://www.imposerpro.com/booklet-imposition-guide/.
duration: Flexible; as much or as little time as the discussion allows
